text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create beautiful paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from huge amounts of human work and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, follows patterns in data. It does not truly feel or understand what it makes. So while AI can help artists and writers, it cannot replace the human heart and mind behind real creative work.
